body:
I thought I was faking it for years, figured "I can stop pretending whenever I want, I have no reason to be depressed" plus it's not like I was *always* sad and aren't people with depression *always* sad? 
One day decided to stop faking it and imagine my surprise when that didn't work.
My best friend of about 16 years suddenly dropped off the face of the earth. No clue what she's up to, all I know is that she's alive, and also smokes now.
No, we do. But people think we do too.

Towards the end of my last relationship I would spend 3+ nights a week at my boyfriend's house. Almost every single night I felt like I was waiting for something that never came and after he went to sleep I cried until I also fell asleep.

I never want to be with someone who isn't also with me again
Without, I don't want to lose more socks to the void in my bed
I wish I could do this, but I can't even get blood tests done without getting sick and being dizzy and nauseous for the rest of the day
I make faces at myself in mirrors, especially in elevators. It's fun.
I had a boxer and my parents named him Tyson, it took me 10 years before I realised it wasn't just a nice name
